correctness.rationale: The helper implements the full documented exit contract (0 CONVERGED/QUIET_ELAPSED, 2 TIMEOUT, 3 SHA_CHANGED, 4 API_ERROR), honors INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, reads scripts/lib/bot-allowlist.txt, brackets each snapshot with pre/post head GraphQL fetches, paginates reviews/comments/threads (including extra thread-comment pages), and emits machine-readable RESULT= lines with HEAD= when available. pr-poll-state.jq encodes conservative v0 semantics: CONVERGED requires every participating allow-listed bot to be terminal on the current head with zero unresolved bot-rooted threads; QUIET_ELAPSED is blocked while any current-head PENDING review exists; comment-only bot activity and DISMISSED reviews do not prove convergence. One point withheld because bundle-only grading provides no live gh/GraphQL execution artifact to confirm runtime polling behavior end-to-end.

quality.rationale: Implementation is repo-consistent and maintainable: core state derivation is extracted to scripts/lib/jq/{bot-allowlist-normalize,pr-poll-state}.jq, the poll script uses set -euo pipefail/umask 077 and structured emit_result/require_cmd helpers, docs are synced across pr-resolve-all.md (settle-window section plus dispatch table), AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, docs/guides/agent-pipeline.md, and install.sh, and allow-list parity is enforced across prompt/workflow/doc mirrors. Minor deduction for a 13-file diff that includes workflow YAML churn beyond the four required paths and for AI_REPO_GUIDE.md tree listing regressions (removed test-*.sh and nested scripts/lib/jq entries from the ASCII tree while the table below still references them).

process.rationale: No forbidden paths (.context/sessions, .context/state), no AGENTS.md or PLAN.md churn, and all changed surfaces relate to the helper, allow-list, tests/check wiring, or required doc/prompt companions. Test wiring (scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh, scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats) and doc companions satisfy repo maintenance expectations. One point withheld because the diff also touches agent-fix-reviews.yml, agent-relay-reviews.yml, and install.sh—justified allow-list synchronization, but slightly broader than the acceptance criterion to keep the diff focused on helper plus required docs/checks.

reliability.rationale: Verification design is exceptionally strong offline: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats (~756 lines) mock gh GraphQL fixtures and exercise CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, API_ERROR subtypes (MISSING_GH, MISSING_ALLOWLIST, GRAPHQL_HEAD, TIMESTAMP_PARSE, ALLOWLIST_PARSE_FAIL), pending/stale-head edge cases, host-qualified GH_REPO auth targeting, and cross-surface allow-list parity; jq-filters.bats adds direct unit tests for the extracted filters; objective evidence confirms test_wiring (6/6), bash -n, and shell lint passed. Full bats execution was skipped in bundle-only objective grading, but static coverage credibly exercises the contract paths.

coordination.rationale: Pipeline expectations require observable role-dispatch evidence in the final response (roles invoked, completion status, per-role changes/decisions). candidate.md contains only the task specification, sanitized metadata, and the diff artifact with no roles-invoked transcript, handoff log, or subagent completion record. The patch reads as a cohesive monolithic deliverable despite being a pipeline-class task, so coordination credit is limited to implicit task-appropriate scope rather than demonstrated multi-role orchestration.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective-grade.json; reliability uncertain flag reflects absent executed test output despite strong static/mock coverage in the diff.
No role-dispatch or subagent handoff evidence appears in candidate.md; coordination scored conservatively from absence of observable orchestration artifacts.

build_state fetches head before and after review/comment/thread snapshots and returns SHA_CHANGED (exit 3) when pre_sha != post_sha.
